title: Finite free map near the generic point
statement: Let Z be an integral Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-pc-integral-scheme] and G a coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. There exist r ≥ 0, an open U containing the generic point ξ, and a map from the restriction to U of the free structure-module sheaf on ULift (Fin r) to G restricted to U, such that its stalk map at ξ in U is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: Coherence gives finite type. Apply finite_moduleStalk_of_isFiniteType at the generic point; its ring stalk is the function field, which Mathlib makes a field. Module.finBasis gives a basis of rank r, reindexed by ULift (Fin r). Use exists_finite_free_moduleStalk_linearEquiv and this basis to build the stalk module isomorphism from the finite free source to G.

Construct the finite free sheaf presentation with empty relations and identity generator map. Presentation.isFinitePresentation gives finite presentation, hence quasi-coherence and finite type. Apply the locally Noetherian coherence criterion and exists_open_hom_of_coherent_stalk_map to extend the basis isomorphism. Its elementwise equality identifies the resulting stalk map composed with the two additive restriction-stalk comparisons with the basis isomorphism. Cancel the bijective comparisons using Function.Bijective.of_comp_iff and of_comp_iff' and use ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective. Rank zero is included.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_free_neighbourhood (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (U : Z.Opens) (hx : genericPoint Z ∈ U)
      (φ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
          (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{w} (Fin r))) ⟶
        (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G),
      IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
        (⟨genericPoint Z, hx⟩ : U.toScheme)).map φ)
